# The Heavens Declare (Psalm 19:1)

## Emotional Focus
Wonder at the sky and stars that tell us about God.

## Key KJV
“The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.” (Psalm 19:1)

## Gentle Retelling
When we look up at the sky, the sun, moon, and stars, they are quietly telling us how great and wonderful God is. He made them all with love.

## Coloring Prompt
Night sky filled with twinkling stars and a gentle moon over peaceful hills.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“The stars are singing about God. You can whisper thank You to Him tonight.”
